answer: Every identity must weave one thread into a shared opal loom, and the k-th thread needs the k-th nonagonal number of knots: the first 1, the second 9, the third 24, the fourth 46, so ten identities pay 1,210 knots and the tenth alone pays 325. Each thread must dry one tide per earlier thread, so the hundredth fake waits 99 tides before its thread counts.
